def to_csv(self):
        # Generate CSV header
        header = "student," + ",".join(self.assignments) + ",percent,letter\n"
        
        # Generate CSV data for each student
        csv_data = []
        for student in sorted(self.students):
            student_data = [student]
            for assignment in self.assignments:
                score = self.grades.get(student, {}).get(assignment, "")
                student_data.append(str(score))
            percent = self.percent(student)
            letter = self.letter_grade(percent)
            student_data.extend([f"{percent:.2f}" if percent is not None else "", letter])
            csv_data.append(",".join(student_data))
        
        # Join all lines with newline
        return header + "\n".join(csv_data)

        # Generate CSV header
        header = "student," + ",".join(self.assignments) + ",percent,letter\n"
        
        # Generate CSV data for each student
        csv_data = []
        for student in sorted(self.students):
            student_data = [student]
            for assignment in self.assignments:
                score = self.grades.get(student, {}).get(assignment, "")
                student_data.append(str(score))
            percent = self.percent(student)
            letter = self.letter_grade(percent)
            student_data.extend([f"{percent:.2f}" if percent is not None else "", letter])
            csv_data.append(",".join(student_data))
        
        # Join all lines with newline
